app.name: DhanSaathi
app.tagline: DhanSaathi looks at your transactions and tells you what's right for your money now — and what isn't.

why.title: Why?
why.checklistIntro: Every suggestion passes through these checks first. No AI can override them.
why.driversIntro: The things about your money that mattered most.
why.noAttribution: There isn't enough data yet to explain this.

constraint.C1: Loan payments would stay within half your income
constraint.C2: A new loan keeps payments under 40% of income

consent.title: Your data
consent.intro: DhanSaathi only looks at what you allow. Turn a permission off and the features that need it genuinely stop working.
consent.marketingNote: Stays off unless you turn it on yourself.
scope.transaction_analysis: Look at my transactions to understand my income and spending
scope.product_recommendation: Suggest which product suits me — including none
scope.credit_assessment: Check what I can repay before suggesting any credit
scope.anomaly_monitoring: Tell me if something unusual happens in my account
